summary.text: Thomas Kutz is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 87, which he has represented since December 2022, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
An attorney, he previously worked as a congressional staff member on the U.S. House Committee on Ways & Means and as policy director in the Pennsylvania State Senate.

paragraphs.text: Kutz was born in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Cedar Cliff High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Grove City College in 2016 and a law degree from Widener University Commonwealth Law School in 2022.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a seventh-generation Cumberland County resident who grew up in Mechanicsburg and lives there with his wife.
In the 2023-2024 session Kutz was assigned to the House Appropriations, Urban Affairs & Housing, and Insurance committees, serving as secretary of the Insurance Committee.
In the same survey, Kutz listed three campaign messages: affordability for families, competitiveness for job creators, and fiscal discipline.
He said he is passionate about tax and budget policy, workforce policy, infrastructure policy and government accessibility, accountability and transparency.
